features.featureTitle: In frontend/src/index.css, replace all black background color values (e.g., `#000`, `#000000`, `black`, dark OKLCH background variables) with royal beige `#DCCBB5` so that the body background is beige across the entire application. Do not change any text colors, glow effects, fonts, button styles, borders, layout, shadows, animations, spacing, or card styles.
